Help Shape the Future of Digital Commerce
We’re looking for a strong Intermediate or Senior eCommerce Developer to
join our tight-knit ECOM team at First Software. In this role, you’ll be the
technical right hand to our Lead eCommerce Manager, helping drive the
architecture, implementation, and ongoing evolution of our B2B and B2C
commerce solutions.
This is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the products we
build for leading New Zealand and Australian retailers — while working in a
team that genuinely values innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
What You’ll Do

JD example

1


Lead the development of scalable, secure, and customer-focused
eCommerce solutions using .NET technologies.
Take ownership of complex builds — from database design to front-end
user experience.
Review code, mentor intermediate developers, and champion best
practices.
Work directly with clients to scope projects, understand requirements, and
deliver exceptional outcomes.
Stay ahead of eCommerce trends, and bring fresh ideas to the table around
UX, performance, and conversion.
What You’ll Bring
4+ years of professional experience with C#, .NET MVC, SQL, and
JavaScript.
Strong understanding of development principles and design patterns.
Hands-on experience with modern JavaScript frameworks — Vue
preferred.
Deep knowledge of HTML/CSS and a strong eye for responsive UI.
Confident and strong communication skills since you will work directly with
our clients to carry out requests and projects
Proven experience in eCommerce development — ideally in both B2C and
B2B contexts.
Shopify experience is not required but would be advantageous.
Why you will want to join us!
The First Software office is bright and modern
Conveniently located in Auckland’s city fringe
Long service leave - After 6 years, you will receive 1 additional week of leave
every year
Weekly learning and development opportunities
A fun and active social club
